preserve-image.next: Inspect silhouette, facing, contrast, overlaps and factual cues at actual size in each consuming mode before proposing a successor.
preserve-image.reason: Preserve the exact registered raster; its declared review stage is historical source evidence, not current whole-board approval.

repair-missing.next: Resolve the missing binding or document an intentional supported fallback; regenerate and verify before visual qualification.
repair-missing.reason: A current actor or player binding requests a compiled slot absent from the supplied compiled metadata.

repair-patrol-rig.next: Review the prepared body and matching new rig together. Inspect historical/manual images for baked blades before adding any moving layer.
repair-patrol-rig.reason: The prepared Field Kit patrol image has no registered rotor anchors. A runtime adapter or candidate does not change this registered metadata.

repair-player-proportions.next: Compare the native reference-v2 candidate at 20/24/32 CSS pixels, four headings and held/moving states. Adopt only a reviewed successor; do not retrofit immutable anchors.
repair-player-proportions.reason: The registered Field Kit rig retains the small rotor proportions rejected in the current user review. Preserve the original body/revision while preparing a separately reviewed body and matching rig.

review-component.next: Trace the consuming painter and inspect normal, warning, active, recovery, pause and reduced-effects states where applicable; retain factual cues when decoration is disabled.
review-component.reason: A component/recipe binding is declared; metadata alone does not prove runtime consumption, visible motion, complete state playback or current review.

review-fpv-selection.next: Inspect the actual appearance chosen by each host, including inherited Team states; record the selected asset/rig identity alongside rendered evidence.
review-fpv-selection.reason: The current source records an available FPV body slot; explicit appearances, uploads and retained choices can override it. Per-player selection is not read by this audit.

review-material.next: Review one instance of every distinct role/runtime/material binding, then its owner boards for clipping, markers and visual overlap. Preserve simulation identity.
review-material.reason: The current mission resolves a campaign material separately from the optional FPV body. A shared material is not evidence that every role/owner was visually inspected.

review-unknown.next: Add an explicit reader/classification and a regression case, or record a scoped manual inspection with exact source and owner identities.
review-unknown.reason: This slot/category or ownership scope is not classified by the bounded audit. Unknown does not mean unused, absent or approved.
